description: Change console language, time zone and email notification switches. Pass only the fields to change; the others keep their values. Low-balance alerts use fixed tiers ($100, $50, $10, $5, $1, one email the first time the balance drops below each) and can only be turned on or off. Security notifications can be turned on here but only turned off in the console (false returns settings_change_denied). An unknown field returns an error that lists the allowed ones. Returns the full settings after the change: language, timezone, notifications (each switch, low_balance_tiers, recipient_verified) and updated_at; the account email gets a notice that settings changed. Example: {"timezone": "Asia/Singapore", "weekly_usage_digest": true}. Needs the settings:write account scope, which is off by default and can only be granted by the account owner in the console.

billing_notifications.description: Spend-threshold and rate-package emails, default on

language.description: Console and email language, default zh-CN

low_balance_notifications.description: Email at each fixed low-balance tier, default on

partner_notifications.description: Referral partner emails (welcome, first click, sign-up, commission, payout), default on

product_updates.description: New platforms and features, default off

security_notifications.description: First use of a key and sign-in from a new country, default on; can only be set true here

service_notices.description: Notice when an API you called had a problem and is fixed, default on

timezone.description: IANA name, e.g. Asia/Singapore, default Asia/Shanghai

weekly_usage_digest.description: Weekly calls and spend summary, default off

name: everyinfra_settings_update
title: Update account settings
